case_number: Crl. Appeal No. 1136 of 2014 a/w Crl. Appeal 1933 of 2014; 2023INSC852
summary: Conviction for drug trafficking; death sentence for repeat offender set aside due to procedural irregularity in Murder Reference; reliance on prior conviction under NDPS Act; admissibility of Section 67 NDPS Act confessions without corroboration; proper authentication of chain of custody; co-accused sentenced to 14 years RI and fine; impugned judgment reversed to restore death penalty.
legal_provisions_cited: Kanhaiyalal vs. Union of India 2008 (4) SCC 668
Ram Singh vs. Central Bureau of Narcotics (2011) 11 SCC 347
Raj Kumar Karwal vs. Union of India (1990) 2 SCC 409
final_judgment: Appeals allowed; High Court judgment set aside; death sentence restored for repeat offender; 14-year sentence upheld for co-accused.
